prompt: Ella: a slender adult woman, always airborne. Tall pointed witch hat with a wide brim, its tip bent over and curling back. Long wavy dark brown hair streams loose past her waist. A dark cloth mask covers her whole face; two small gold eye glints are its only light. A separate long ragged scarf with two tails. Fitted buttoned dark jacket with belt, long sleeves, layered skirt with sawtooth hems to the knee, knit stockings, laced boots, gloves, every inch covered. The umbrella is the only object she holds: an open shallow dome two-thirds as wide as she is tall, eight gores alternating deep umber and mid taupe, scalloped hem; a long thin dark shaft ending in a narrow pierced diamond; at the peak a short dark stem on a small collar ends in one round bead with a tiny point. Both gloved hands grip the shaft. Pose first: level side view facing right, Ella falls slowly, torso upright, both legs hanging straight down, limp, boots side by side pointing at the ground. She holds the umbrella level at waist height like a lance, both hands on the shaft, finial behind her, diamond pointing right; hair and scarf stream back. Three figures in a row, 21:9, level camera, same scale, 60% of canvas height, green between them. Left: canopy furled along the shaft. Middle: canopy snapped open behind her, a small separate gold pulse flies right, clear of her. Right: canopy half closed, air ahead empty. The attached image shows only her open umbrella; copy its design. Dark etched storybook engraving for a 2D sprite: brown-black ink, sepia wash, fine cross-hatching. Mid-tone umber and taupe cloth (#3A2C25, #5C473E, #7A6558), pale taupe (#B9A892) on scarf and gloves; near-black only as hairline ink and the hat crown. Thin rim light and 3 px outline in warm apricot-cream (#FFE6C4, touches of gold #E9C46A). Flat pure green #00FF00 background, edge to edge, empty. Figure colours: umber, taupe, cream, gold. Wordless.
